camel_example: aliyun live UpdateLiveAppSnapshotConfig --region cn-hangzhou --OverwriteOssObject 'liveApp0000_/_liveStream0000_.jpg' --SequenceOssObject 'snapshot/_liveApp0000_/_liveStream0000_/_UnixTimestamp0000_.jpg' --Callback 'https://learn.aliyundoc.com' --TimeInterval 5 --OssEndpoint 'cn-oss-0000.aliyuncs.com' --DomainName 'example.com' --OssBucket liveBucket0000 --AppName liveApp0000
description_en: Modifies a snapshot configuration of a streaming domain. The captured snapshots are stored in Object Storage Service (OSS). The modification takes effect after you restart stream ingest
description_zh: 更新直播流下的截图配置。输出内容保存到OSS中，重新推流后生效
kebab_example: aliyun live update-live-app-snapshot-config --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --time-interval 5 --oss-endpoint cn-oss-0000.aliyuncs.com --oss-bucket liveBucket0000 --overwrite-oss-object liveApp0000_/_liveStream0000_.jpg --sequence-oss-object snapshot/_liveApp0000_/_liveStream0000_/_UnixTimestamp0000_.jpg --callback https://learn.aliyundoc.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLiveAppSnapshotConfig

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The interval at which snapshots are captured. Valid values: **5 to 3600**. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 截图周期。取值范围：**5~3600**。单位：秒
parameters.name: time_interval

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the OSS bucket
parameters.name: oss_endpoint

parameters.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket
parameters.name: oss_bucket

parameters.help_en:
The naming format of snapshots that are stored in the overwrite mode, which means that a new snapshot overwrites the previous snapshot.

- The name must be less than 256 bytes in length.

- Only JPG images are supported.

- The name can contain variables such as {AppName} and {StreamName}.

- A value of hyphen (-) indicates that this parameter is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
覆盖截图存储文件名。每次截图都覆盖此文件。

- 小于256 Byte。
- 目前仅支持生成JPG图片。
- 支持变量匹配，包含 {AppName}、{StreamName}。
- 传入短划线（-），表示删除此字段
parameters.name: overwrite_oss_object

parameters.help_en:
The naming format of snapshots that are stored in sequence, which means that a new snapshot does not overwrite the previous snapshot. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847902.html operation to query the snapshots that were captured within a specific time period.

- The name must be less than 256 bytes in length.

- Only JPG images are supported.

- The name can contain variables such as {AppName}, {StreamName}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence}. The name must contain at least one of the {UnixTimestamp} and {Sequence} variables.

- A value of hyphen (-) indicates that this parameter is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
实时截图存储文件名。每次截图都递增存储，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847902.html接口，可以查询某一段时间的文件。

- 小于256 Byte。
- 目前仅支持生成JPG图片。
- 支持变量匹配，包含 {AppName}、{StreamName}、{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}，其中 {UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence} 必填一个。
- 传入短划线（-），表示删除此字段
parameters.name: sequence_oss_object

parameters.help_en: The callback URL that is used to receive notifications about snapshot capture
parameters.name: callback
